info.description:
AfyaMind telemedicine platform REST API.
**Authentication:** Most protected endpoints require a JWT Bearer token.
Login via POST /auth/login, then click the **Authorize** button above and enter: `Bearer <your_token>`
info.title: AfyaMind API

post.description: Patient approves a pending access request from a clinic.
Patient denies a pending access request from a clinic.
Schedules a consultation between a patient and the doctor. Enforces access guard permissions.
If the email matches an account, sends a password reset link to it. Returns success regardless to prevent user enumeration.

Validates credentials and sets HttpOnly JWT cookies (access_token + refresh_token).
Provide either email or phone, together with password.
Clears the access_token and refresh_token HttpOnly cookies.

Issues a new access_token cookie. Reads the refresh token from the HttpOnly cookie by default.
Optionally accepts a JSON body with refresh_token for non-cookie clients.

parameters.description: Optional: refresh token in JSON body
parameters.name: body

post.description:
Creates a new patient account and sets HttpOnly JWT cookies (access_token + refresh_token).
Also aliased at POST /auth/signup.

409.description: Email or phone already in use

post.description: Resets the password if the token is valid and unexpired. Clears reset token cookie.

get.description: Returns a list of all registered healthcare clinics. Super Admin only.

post.description: Registers a new healthcare clinic and seeds its first admin. Super Admin only.

409.description: Clinic email already registered or status conflict

get.description: Retrieves clinical information for a single clinic. Super Admin or Clinic Admin.
Lists access requests. Filterable by status (pending, approved, denied, expired).
get.summary: List access requests for a clinic

post.description: Initiates a request for a clinic/doctor to view patient health records.
post.summary: Create access request for a patient

post.description: Clinic admin revokes a previously approved access request.

patch.description: Changes status of the clinic to active. Super Admin only.
Changes status of the clinic to deactivated. Super Admin only.

get.description: Lists all doctors registered under a specific clinic. Super Admin or Clinic Admin.

patch.description: Activates a doctor's account in the specified clinic. Clinic admin only.
Deactivates a doctor's account in the specified clinic. Clinic admin only.

get.description: Lists all sent invitations for a specific clinic. Super Admin or Clinic Admin.

post.description: Sends an invitation email to a doctor. Accessible by clinic admins.
post.summary: Invite a doctor to the clinic

get.description: Returns full details of an encounter including vitals, lab results, diagnoses and prescriptions.
Retrieves the clinical evaluation details associated with a clinical encounter.

post.description: Records symptoms, past history, allergies and physical examination details. Enforces doctor access.
post.summary: Create a clinical evaluation for an encounter

patch.description: Marks a clinical encounter session as closed/finalized. Doctor only.

get.description: Returns a summary of the patient's medical history from the vantage point of this encounter.

post.description: Doctor accepts invitation and fills in profile to complete registration.

get.description: Looks up a patient by their exact email. Accessible by clinic admins.
Retrieves all scheduled/past appointments for a specific patient. Filterable by status.

parameters.description: Filter by appointment status (scheduled, attended, cancelled)
parameters.name: status

get.description: Retrieves all encounters recorded for a specific patient. Supports pagination.

post.description: Opens a clinical encounter session for a patient. Enforces doctor access.

get.description: Returns the full profile of the authenticated user.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the authenticated user's account. This action is irreversible.

patch.description: Partially updates the authenticated user's profile. All fields are optional.

put.description:
Updates the authenticated user's password after verifying the current one.
Accessible via both PUT and PATCH on /users/me/password.

401.description: Not authenticated or wrong current password
